start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-notes-into-finished-content." Turn a person's notes, a recording or a principle into one finished piece in one of their formats (a post, thread, newsletter, article, script or talk): start from what they have already said, tell it as a story that changes the reader, write it in their format citing their own words, check every line against their copywriting laws and aloud, and run the copy judge before the draft is kept.

3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is judge.
